NEWS: Morgan Stanley has initiated coverage on SpaceX with an Overweight rating.

The firm expects SpaceX to outperform most investments on Wall Street and sees 90% upside from its valuation.

Morgan Stanley also projects SpaceX could generate more than $3.3 trillion in annual revenue by 2040, highlighting its long-term growth potential.
